"""Reproducible bounded model experiment; no plaintext or key lookup."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

REPO = Path('/Users/chasehendrick/Documents/Codex/undeciphered-texts-ship/repo')
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO))
from engine.k4_models import search_k4_models, AZ, KRYPTOS_MIXED
from engine.reverse_engineer import Crib
from tests.test_k4_models import PLAIN, REPEATING_CIPHER, AUTOKEY_CIPHER, BEAUFORT_CIPHER, CIPHER_AUTOKEY, oracle

CT = 'OBKRUOXOGHULBSOLIFBBWFLRVQQPRNGKSSOTWTQSJQSSEKZZWATJKLUDIAWINFBNYPVTTMZFPKWGDKZXTJCDIGKUHUAUEKCAR'
EAST_NORTHEAST = Crib(21, 'EASTNORTHEAST')
BERLIN_CLOCK = Crib(63, 'BERLINCLOCK')
TOTAL_LIMIT = 10000


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def heldout(mask, crib):
    predicted = mask[crib.offset:crib.offset + len(crib.plaintext)]
    unknown = [crib.offset + i for i, ch in enumerate(predicted) if ch == '?']
    mismatches = [{'offset': crib.offset + i, 'predicted': ch, 'expected': expected}
                  for i, (ch, expected) in enumerate(zip(predicted, crib.plaintext))
                  if ch != '?' and ch != expected]
    return {'status': 'contradicted' if mismatches else 'underdetermined' if unknown else 'exact_prediction',
            'predicted_span': predicted, 'determined_letters': len(predicted) - len(unknown),
            'matching_determined_letters': sum(ch == expected for ch, expected in zip(predicted, crib.plaintext)),
            'unknown_offsets': unknown, 'mismatches': mismatches,
            'used_for_fitting': False, 'used_for_key_completion': False, 'used_for_ranking': False}


started = time.perf_counter()
paths = [REPO/'engine/k4_models.py', REPO/'tests/test_k4_models.py', REPO/'engine/reverse_engineer.py', Path(__file__)]
hashes_before = {str(p.relative_to(REPO)) if p.is_relative_to(REPO) else str(p): digest(p) for p in paths}
result = {
    'schema_version': 1, 'experiment': 'K4 exact modular substitution and ragged transposition compositions',
    'date': '2026-10-03', 'started_at_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'status': 'not_solved', 'new_verified_plaintext': False, 'claimed_plaintext': None,
    'status_scope': 'Public cryptanalytic recovery not established; 2025 private archival recovery and sale acknowledged.',
    'ciphertext': CT, 'ciphertext_length': len(CT), 'ciphertext_sha256': hashlib.sha256(CT.encode('ascii')).hexdigest(),
    'coordinates': 'Zero-based original plaintext letter positions, before any tested transposition.',
    'clue_groups': [{'offset': 21, 'plaintext': 'EASTNORTHEAST', 'ciphertext_span': CT[21:34]},
                   {'offset': 63, 'plaintext': 'BERLINCLOCK', 'ciphertext_span': CT[63:74]}],
    'sources': [
        {'role': 'Custodian sculpture transcription; undated legacy status not used as current global proof', 'url': 'https://www.cia.gov/legacy/headquarters/kryptos-sculpture/'},
        {'role': 'Participant transcription and aligned artist-disclosure mask, checked by evidence audit', 'url': 'https://www.elonka.com/kryptos/'},
        {'role': 'Independent participant ciphertext transcription', 'url': 'https://www.elonka.com/kryptos/transcript.html'},
        {'role': 'First-party 2025 archive sale account; not technical replay or independent archive-content verification', 'url': 'https://content.rrauction.com/jim-sanborns-complete-kryptos-archive-sells-for-962500-at-auction/'},
        {'role': 'Repeating Vigenere definition', 'url': 'https://www.cryptogram.org/downloads/aca.info/ciphers/Vigenere.pdf'},
        {'role': 'Beaufort definition', 'url': 'https://www.cryptogram.org/downloads/aca.info/ciphers/Beaufort.pdf'},
        {'role': 'Plaintext-autokey definition; ciphertext-autokey here is separately declared as a constructed recurrence', 'url': 'https://www.cryptogram.org/downloads/aca.info/ciphers/Autokey.pdf'}],
    'prior_experiments': ['../logs/open-target-attempt-2026-10-03.json', '../logs/tractable-open-attempt-2026-10-03.json'],
    'new_coverage': ['Ragged final row permits columnar widths for prime-length97 input',
                     'Substitution before or after transposition, with original plaintext coordinates preserved',
                     'Exact periodic/Beaufort/plaintext-autokey/ciphertext-autokey constraints under A-Z and fixed KRYPTOS alphabet',
                     'EAST participates in an explicit new fold with NORTHEAST; prior folds omitted EAST'],
    'assumptions': ['No sourced requirement proves that K4 uses these families, alphabets, layouts or periods.',
                    'Modular alphabet indices have origin zero; no artist keyword or indicator letter is inferred.',
                    'No padding, nulls, missing letters, errors, English completion, clock keystream or proposed full plaintext.',
                    'Ciphertext-autokey means C[i]=P[i]+C[i-period] modulo26 after supplied-unknown primer shifts.'],
    'check_unit': 'One layout/family/alphabet/order/period hypothesis fitted algebraically. This is not one enumerated key completion.',
    'global_model_check_limit_including_controls': TOTAL_LIMIT,
    'constraint_work_bound': 'Each check traverses at most512 intermediate letters and at most512 unique crib positions; complete keys additionally forward-replay at most512 letters. Seed domains are algebraic, not 26^period brute force.',
    'random_seed': None, 'determinism': 'No RNG, learning or language scoring used. Fixed enumeration and forced-position ranking.',
    'git_head_at_start': subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=REPO,text=True).strip(),
    'python': sys.version, 'code_hashes_before': hashes_before, 'controls': [], 'folds': []}

for name, cipher, family, alphabet, expected_key, order in [
    ('ragged-repeating',REPEATING_CIPHER,'repeating',AZ,(12,0,15),'substitute-then-transpose'),
    ('ragged-keyed-plaintext-autokey',AUTOKEY_CIPHER,'plaintext-autokey',KRYPTOS_MIXED,(17,7,3),'substitute-then-transpose'),
    ('transposition-first-beaufort',BEAUFORT_CIPHER,'beaufort',AZ,(12,0,15),'transpose-then-substitute'),
    ('ragged-ciphertext-autokey',CIPHER_AUTOKEY,'ciphertext-autokey',AZ,(12,0,15),'substitute-then-transpose')]:
    r = search_k4_models(cipher, cribs=(Crib(0, PLAIN[:21]),), max_period=3,max_width=7,
                         max_checks=1000,max_candidates=1000,alphabets=(alphabet,),families=(family,),orders=(order,))
    hit = next(c for c in r['candidates'] if c['layout']=={'kind':'ragged-columnar','width':7,'direction':'left-to-right'} and c['period']==3)
    assert hit['predicted_plaintext']==PLAIN and hit['key_shift_indices']==list(expected_key)
    assert oracle(PLAIN,family,expected_key,alphabet,7,order)==cipher
    result['controls'].append({'name':name,'fixture_kind':'Frozen constructed repository harbor-prose prefix; not historical ciphertext',
       'ciphertext':cipher,'fitted_crib':{'offset':0,'plaintext':PLAIN[:21]},'checks':r['checks'],'search_complete':r['search_complete'],
       'tool_name':'k4-models','key_or_expected_full_plaintext_supplied_to_search':False,
       'recovered_plaintext':hit['predicted_plaintext'],'recovered_output_sha256':hashlib.sha256(hit['predicted_plaintext'].encode('ascii')).hexdigest(),
       'expected_output_sha256':hashlib.sha256(PLAIN.encode('ascii')).hexdigest(),'recovered_shift_indices':hit['key_shift_indices'],
       'forward_matches_frozen_ciphertext':hit['re_encryption_matches'],'independent_oracle_matches':True})

control_checks = sum(c['checks'] for c in result['controls'])
limits = [(TOTAL_LIMIT-control_checks)//2, (TOTAL_LIMIT-control_checks)-(TOTAL_LIMIT-control_checks)//2]
for (fit, reserved), limit in zip([(EAST_NORTHEAST,BERLIN_CLOCK),(BERLIN_CLOCK,EAST_NORTHEAST)],limits):
    r = search_k4_models(CT, cribs=(fit,), max_checks=limit,max_period=32,max_width=32,max_candidates=10000)
    assert not r['candidates_truncated']
    tally={'exact_prediction':0,'contradicted':0,'underdetermined':0}
    complete_tally=dict(tally)
    grouped={}
    evaluations=[]
    for c in r['candidates']:
        check=heldout(c['predicted_plaintext'],reserved)
        evaluations.append(check)
        tally[check['status']]+=1
        if c['key_complete']: complete_tally[check['status']]+=1
        label=c['family']+'|'+c['alphabet']+'|'+c['order']
        grouped.setdefault(label, {'compatible_models':0,'complete_keys':0,'heldout':dict.fromkeys(tally,0)})
        grouped[label]['compatible_models']+=1
        grouped[label]['complete_keys']+=int(c['key_complete'])
        grouped[label]['heldout'][check['status']]+=1
    # Predeclared witness rule depends only on fit-side completeness and the
    # runner's stable ranking. The reserved letters never select witnesses.
    picked=[]
    for complete in (True,False):
        picked.extend([i for i,c in enumerate(r['candidates']) if c['key_complete']==complete][:5])
    witnesses=[{**r['candidates'][i],'heldout':evaluations[i]} for i in picked]
    r.pop('candidates')
    r['temporary_candidate_storage_limit']=r['bounds']['max_candidates']
    r['saved_witness_limit']=10
    r['witness_rule']='First5 complete-key and first5 partial-key hypotheses in fitting-only stable ranking; selected before reserved evaluation.'
    r['witnesses']=witnesses
    r['heldout_counts_all_compatible_models']=tally
    r['heldout_counts_complete_keys']=complete_tally
    r['group_results']=grouped
    r['fully_forced_keys']=sum(complete_tally.values())
    r['fit']={'offset':fit.offset,'plaintext':fit.plaintext}
    r['reserved']={'offset':reserved.offset,'plaintext':reserved.plaintext}
    r['validation_rule']='Determined mismatch rejects hypothesis; ? is unknown, not match. No reserved evidence completes keys, ranks, selects witnesses or refits models.'
    result['folds'].append(r)

result['control_checks']=control_checks
result['target_checks']=sum(f['checks'] for f in result['folds'])
result['total_model_checks']=control_checks+result['target_checks']
assert result['total_model_checks']<=TOTAL_LIMIT
result['source_hashes_unchanged_during_run']=hashes_before=={str(p.relative_to(REPO)) if p.is_relative_to(REPO) else str(p):digest(p) for p in paths}
assert result['source_hashes_unchanged_during_run']
result['completed_at_utc']=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
result['elapsed_seconds']=time.perf_counter()-started
result['reproduction_script']=Path(__file__).read_text()
out=REPO/'docs/k4-focus/model-experiments-2026-10-03.json'
out.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:result[k] for k in ('control_checks','target_checks','total_model_checks','elapsed_seconds')},indent=2))
for f in result['folds']:
    print(json.dumps({k:f[k] for k in ('fit','reserved','checks','requested_models','compatible_models','rejected_models','fully_forced_keys','heldout_counts_all_compatible_models','heldout_counts_complete_keys','search_complete','stop_reason')},indent=2))
